sentences.text: Adidas AG -LRB- -LSB- ˈadiˌdas -RSB- -RRB- -LRB- stylised as adidas since 1949 -RRB- is a German multinational corporation , headquartered in Herzogenaurach , Germany , that designs and manufactures shoes , clothing and accessories .	accessories	Fashion accessory	Herzogenaurach	Herzogenaurach	Germany	Germany	AG	Aktiengesellschaft	German	Germany	multinational corporation	multinational corporation
